title: App Store header (iOS 27), the one film
brief: The iOS 27 App Store product-page header (21:9, 3840 × 1646) and search card (3:2, 2880 × 1920) allow ONE muted loop each, so this is the one film: A (her photos give up what she's wearing; it becomes her real Wardrobe, build 284) → B (the black tee flies onto her walk-to-work photo; Studio's real try-on) → C (a week of looks on tonal cards) → the Curate lockup with the app's own line, Try it. Style it. Wear it. → back to frame 0. 30 s, one seamless loop, in the subtle palette (A2 tonal, B3, C2 subtle). The first 5 s land on their own: by 4 s the photos have given up the coat, jacket and scarf and they stand beside her Wardrobe. One camera through one long studio: every beat arrives on the same slow camera glide to the right (C's rail camera), through a soft column of light. Reuses B and C by import (their compositions, retimed by a pure time map); A runs a faster cut of its own picture.
hook: 0–5 s: three of her photos on Mist; 0.35 s 'Your closet is already in your photos.'; the coat, jacket and scarf lift out one at a time (blush, dusty blue, oat); 3.1 s they gather beside her real Wardrobe on the phone; 3.7 s 'Every item you own, from your photos.'
